label: Auto reply drafts
description: Turns new Slack messages that need a reply into drafted reply sessions. Drafting only; sending always waits for approval.

settings.label: Auto reply drafts
settings.help: Master switch. Off means no drafts are written at all; messages are held and picked up whenever it is switched back on.

settings.label: Drafts per hour
settings.help: Most conversations opened in one hour. Anything over the limit is held, not dropped, and the next run picks it up.

settings.label: Drafts per day
settings.help: Most conversations opened in one day. Anything over the limit is held until the next WIB midnight, not dropped.

settings.label: Wait before drafting
settings.help: How long a message waits before it counts as needing a reply, so a burst of messages becomes one draft. Messages are held for this long, never dropped.

settings.label: Quiet hours (WIB)
settings.help: No drafts are written inside this window. Messages arriving here are held and drafted once the window ends.

settings.label: Close a quiet conversation after
settings.help: A reply session with no activity for this long is closed and its chat retired. The draft is kept; only the open session is dropped.

settings.label: Muted channels
settings.help: Messages in these channels are dropped, not held. No later run will reconsider them, so a muted channel is silent by design.

settings.label: Sources
settings.help: Which inboxes are watched. A source switched off means its messages are held, and they are drafted if it is switched back on.

_hosted_by: The ASB app's own ticker (src-tauri/src/auto_drafts.rs), switched by journal/state/automation_config.json auto_reply_drafts.enabled. Not a routines.json job since 19 Sep 2026, so it names no job and no scheduled_runs parent: that switch does not gate it.
